@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

alias weakening := wk

def verum' (h : ⊤ ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (verum Δ).wk (by simp[h])

def axL' {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)
    (h : Semiformula.rel r v ∈ Δ) (hn : Semiformula.nrel r v ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (axL Δ r v).wk (by simp[h, hn])

def all' {φ} (h : ∀' φ ∈ Δ) (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : T ⟹ Δ := d.all.wk (by simp [h])

def ex' {φ} (h : ∃' φ ∈ Δ) (t) (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (d.ex t).wk (by simp [h])

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max n m + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max' (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max m n + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

  ne_of_ne_complexity (by simp)

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

instance : Tait (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  verum := fun _ Δ => verum Δ
  and := fun dp dq => dp.and dq
  or := fun d => d.or
  wk := fun d ss => d.wk ss
  em := fun hp hn => em hp hn

instance : Tait.Cut (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  cut {_ _ _ dp dn} := cut dp dn

def provableOfDerivable {φ} (b : T ⟹. φ) : T ⊢ φ := b

def specialize {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1} (t : SyntacticTerm L) :
    T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Γ := fun d ↦
  have : T ⟹ ∼φ/[t] :: φ/[t] :: Γ := Tait.em (φ := φ/[t]) (by simp) (by simp)
  have dn : T ⟹ ∼(∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ := by
    simp only [neg_all, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    exact Derivation.ex t (by simpa using this)
  have dp : T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ :=
    Derivation.wk d (List.cons_subset_cons _ <| by simp)
  Derivation.cut dp dn

def specializes : {k : ℕ} → {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L k} → {Γ : Sequent L} → (v : Fin k → SyntacticTerm L) →
    T ⟹ (∀* φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ
  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∀' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ := by simpa using specializes (φ := ∀' φ) (v ·.succ) b
    Derivation.cast (specialize (v 0) this) (by
      simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, ← TransitiveRewriting.comp_app, List.cons.injEq, and_true]; congr 2
      ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
      cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp)

def instances : {k : ℕ} → {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L k} → {Γ : Sequent L} → {v : Fin k → SyntacticTerm L} →
    T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ → T ⟹ (∃* φ) :: Γ
  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∃' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ :=
      ex (v 0) <| Derivation.cast b <| by
        unfold Rewriting.substitute; rw [←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app]; congr 3
        ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
        cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp
    instances (k := k) (v := (v ·.succ)) (Derivation.cast this (by simp))

def allClosureFixitr {φ : SyntacticFormula L} (dp : T ⊢ φ) : (m : ℕ) → T ⊢ ∀* Rew.fixitr 0 m ▹ φ
  | 0     => by simpa
  | m + 1 => by
    simp only [allClosure_fixitr, Nat.reduceAdd]
    apply all; simpa using allClosureFixitr dp m

def toClose (b : T ⊢ φ) : T ⊢ ∀∀φ := allClosureFixitr b φ.fvSup

def toClose! (b : T ⊢! φ) : T ⊢! ∀∀φ := by exact?

  verum := fun _ Δ => verum Δ
  and := fun dp dq => dp.and dq
  or := fun d => d.or
  wk := fun d ss => d.wk ss
  em := fun hp hn => em hp hn

instance : Tait.Cut (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  cut {_ _ _ dp dn} := cut dp dn

def provableOfDerivable {φ} (b : T ⟹. φ) : T ⊢ φ := b

def specialize {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1} (t : SyntacticTerm L) :
    T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Γ := fun d ↦
  have : T ⟹ ∼φ/[t] :: φ/[t] :: Γ := Tait.em (φ := φ/[t]) (by simp) (by simp)
  have dn : T ⟹ ∼(∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ := by
    simp only [neg_all, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    exact Derivation.ex t (by simpa using this)
  have dp : T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ :=
    Derivation.wk d (List.cons_subset_cons _ <| by simp)
  Derivation.cut dp dn

def specializes : {k : ℕ} → {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L k} → {Γ : Sequent L} → (v : Fin k → SyntacticTerm L) →
    T ⟹ (∀* φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ
  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∀' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ := by simpa using specializes (φ := ∀' φ) (v ·.succ) b
    Derivation.cast (specialize (v 0) this) (by
      simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, ← TransitiveRewriting.comp_app, List.cons.injEq, and_true]; congr 2
      ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
      cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp)

def instances : {k : ℕ} → {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L k} → {Γ : Sequent L} → {v : Fin k → SyntacticTerm L} →
    T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ → T ⟹ (∃* φ) :: Γ
  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∃' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ :=
      ex (v 0) <| Derivation.cast b <| by
        unfold Rewriting.substitute; rw [←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app]; congr 3
        ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
        cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp
    instances (k := k) (v := (v ·.succ)) (Derivation.cast this (by simp))

def allClosureFixitr {φ : SyntacticFormula L} (dp : T ⊢ φ) : (m : ℕ) → T ⊢ ∀* Rew.fixitr 0 m ▹ φ
  | 0     => by simpa
  | m + 1 => by
    simp only [allClosure_fixitr, Nat.reduceAdd]
    apply all; simpa using allClosureFixitr dp m

def toClose (b : T ⊢ φ) : T ⊢ ∀∀φ := allClosureFixitr b φ.fvSup

def toClose! (b : T ⊢! φ) : T ⊢! ∀∀φ := ⟨toClose b.get⟩

  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0

  | all d       => d.length.succ

  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

def specialize {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1} (t : SyntacticTerm L) :
    T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Γ := fun d ↦
  have : T ⟹ ∼φ/[t] :: φ/[t] :: Γ := Tait.em (φ := φ/[t]) (by simp) (by simp)
  have dn : T ⟹ ∼(∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ := by

    exact Derivation.ex t (by simpa using this)
  have dp : T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ :=
    Derivation.wk d (List.cons_subset_cons _ <| by simp)
  Derivation.cut dp dn

  rw [Rew.eq_bind (Rew.fixitr 0 φ.fvSup)]
  simp only [Function.comp_def, Rew.fixitr_bvar, Rew.fixitr_fvar, Fin.natAdd_mk, zero_add]
  intro h
  rcases fvar?_rew h with (⟨z, hz⟩ | ⟨z, hz, hx⟩)
  · simp at hz
  · have : z < φ.fvSup := lt_fvSup_of_fvar? hz
    simp [this] at hx

To determine whether $φ$ is a free variable in $\Gamma$, we must examine how variables are introduced and managed within the context $\Gamma$. When a new variable is introduced by $\text{newVar}(\Gamma)$, it signifies a variable that has not been previously declared or bound within $\Gamma$. 

Given this, we utilize the lemma `not_fvar?_of_lt_fvSup` which posits that if a formula $φ$ is a member of $\Gamma$, then it cannot be a free variable in the context of a new variable, denoted as $\text{newVar}(\Gamma)$. This lemma likely relies on analyzing the structure of $\Gamma$ and the position of $φ$ within it, ensuring that $φ$ does not appear in a position where it could be considered a free variable when a new variable is introduced.

To validate this, the proof leverages the Lean4-specific function `List.le_max_of_le`, which compares elements within a list, ensuring that the index of $φ$ within this list is appropriately bounded. Additionally, the function `simpa` is used to simplify the goal by applying known equalities, thereby confirming the correctness of the assertion within the context of the new variable.

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

protected abbrev cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : T ⟹ Γ := e ▸ d

@[simp] lemma cast_eq (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Δ) : Derivation.cast d e = d := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

alias weakening := wk

def verum' (h : ⊤ ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (verum Δ).wk (by simp[h])

def axL' {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)
    (h : Semiformula.rel r v ∈ Δ) (hn : Semiformula.nrel r v ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (axL Δ r v).wk (by simp[h, hn])

def all' {φ} (h : ∀' φ ∈ Δ) (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : T ⟹ Δ := d.all.wk (by simp [h])

def ex' {φ} (h : ∃' φ ∈ Δ) (t) (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (d.ex t).wk (by simp [h])

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max n m + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max' (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max m n + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

private lemma neg_ne_and {φ ψ : SyntacticFormula L} : ¬∼φ = φ ⋏ ψ :=
  ne_of_ne_complexity (by simp)

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

instance : Tait (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  verum := fun _ Δ => verum Δ
  and := fun dp dq => dp.and dq
  or := fun d => d.or
  wk := fun d ss => d.wk ss
  em := fun hp hn => em hp hn

instance : Tait.Cut (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  cut {_ _ _ dp dn} := cut dp dn

def provableOfDerivable {φ} (b : T ⟹. φ) : T ⊢ φ := b

def specialize {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1} (t : SyntacticTerm L) :
    T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Γ := fun d ↦
  have : T ⟹ ∼φ/[t] :: φ/[t] :: Γ := Tait.em (φ := φ/[t]) (by simp) (by simp)
  have dn : T ⟹ ∼(∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ := by
    simp only [neg_all, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    exact Derivation.ex t (by simpa using this)
  have dp : T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ :=
    Derivation.wk d (List.cons_subset_cons _ <| by simp)
  Derivation.cut dp dn

def specializes : {k : ℕ} → {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L k} → {Γ : Sequent L} → (v : Fin k → SyntacticTerm L) →
    T ⟹ (∀* φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ
  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∀' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ := by simpa using specializes (φ := ∀' φ) (v ·.succ) b
    Derivation.cast (specialize (v 0) this) (by
      simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, ← TransitiveRewriting.comp_app, List.cons.injEq, and_true]; congr 2
      ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
      cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp)

def instances : {k : ℕ} → {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L k} → {Γ : Sequent L} → {v : Fin k → SyntacticTerm L} →
    T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ → T ⟹ (∃* φ) :: Γ
  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∃' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ :=
      ex (v 0) <| Derivation.cast b <| by
        unfold Rewriting.substitute; rw [←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app]; congr 3
        ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
        cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp
    instances (k := k) (v := (v ·.succ)) (Derivation.cast this (by simp))

def allClosureFixitr {φ : SyntacticFormula L} (dp : T ⊢ φ) : (m : ℕ) → T ⊢ ∀* Rew.fixitr 0 m ▹ φ
  | 0     => by simpa
  | m + 1 => by
    simp only [allClosure_fixitr, Nat.reduceAdd]
    apply all; simpa using allClosureFixitr dp m

def toClose (b : T ⊢ φ) : T ⊢ ∀∀φ := by exact?

  and := fun dp dq => dp.and dq
  or := fun d => d.or
  wk := fun d ss => d.wk ss
  em := fun hp hn => em hp hn

instance : Tait.Cut (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where

def specialize {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1} (t : SyntacticTerm L) :
    T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Γ := fun d ↦
  have : T ⟹ ∼φ/[t] :: φ/[t] :: Γ := Tait.em (φ := φ/[t]) (by simp) (by simp)
  have dn : T ⟹ ∼(∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ := by
    simp only [neg_all, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    exact Derivation.ex t (by simpa using this)
  have dp : T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ :=
    Derivation.wk d (List.cons_subset_cons _ <| by simp)
  Derivation.cut dp dn

    T ⟹ (∀* φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ
  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∀' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ := by simpa using specializes (φ := ∀' φ) (v ·.succ) b
    Derivation.cast (specialize (v 0) this) (by
      simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, ← TransitiveRewriting.comp_app, List.cons.injEq, and_true]; congr 2
      ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
      cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp)

    T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ → T ⟹ (∃* φ) :: Γ
  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∃' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ :=
      ex (v 0) <| Derivation.cast b <| by
        unfold Rewriting.substitute; rw [←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app]; congr 3
        ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
        cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp
    instances (k := k) (v := (v ·.succ)) (Derivation.cast this (by simp))

def allClosureFixitr {φ : SyntacticFormula L} (dp : T ⊢ φ) : (m : ℕ) → T ⊢ ∀* Rew.fixitr 0 m ▹ φ
  | 0     => by simpa
  | m + 1 => by
    simp only [allClosure_fixitr, Nat.reduceAdd]
    apply all; simpa using allClosureFixitr dp m

def toClose (b : T ⊢ φ) : T ⊢ ∀∀φ := allClosureFixitr b φ.fvSup

  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ

  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ

  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

C0_dependencies.content:
def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

def specialize {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1} (t : SyntacticTerm L) :
    T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Γ := fun d ↦
  have : T ⟹ ∼φ/[t] :: φ/[t] :: Γ := Tait.em (φ := φ/[t]) (by simp) (by simp)
  have dn : T ⟹ ∼(∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ := by
    simp only [neg_all, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    exact Derivation.ex t (by simpa using this)
  have dp : T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ :=
    Derivation.wk d (List.cons_subset_cons _ <| by simp)
  Derivation.cut dp dn

rag.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.lt_fvSup_of_fvar?
rag.content:
lemma lt_fvSup_of_fvar? {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L n} : φ.FVar? m → m < φ.fvSup := by
  unfold fvSup FVar?
  intro hm
  have : ∃ s : ℕ, φ.freeVariables.max = s := Finset.max_of_mem hm
  rcases this with ⟨s, hs⟩
  have : m ≤ s := by
    have : (m : WithBot ℕ) ≤ ↑s := by simpa [hs] using Finset.le_max hm
    exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.mp this
  simpa [hs, WithBot.recBotCoe] using Nat.lt_add_one_of_le this

informal_statement: For a given sequent $\Gamma$, `newVar` retrieves the set of free variables from $\Gamma$ and returns the natural number corresponding to the maximum element in that set, initializing the search at $0$.
informal_proof:
The function `newVar` operates on a sequent $\Gamma$ as follows:
1. It applies the `map` function to the result of `Semiformula.fvSup Γ`, which converts the set of free variables in $\Gamma$ into a collection of natural numbers (each representing a variable's index).
2. Using `foldr` with the binary operator `max` and the initial value `0`, it iterates over each element in the result of `Semiformula.fvSup Γ`.
3. With each `max` application, it compares the current accumulated maximum with the next element and updates the maximum if necessary.
4. The result of this process is the highest indexed free variable in $\Gamma$, which is always a natural number.

Therefore, `newVar Γ` produces a natural number equal to the highest indexed free variable present in the sequent $\Gamma$.

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

protected abbrev cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : T ⟹ Γ := e ▸ d

@[simp] lemma cast_eq (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Δ) : Derivation.cast d e = d := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

alias weakening := wk

def verum' (h : ⊤ ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (verum Δ).wk (by simp[h])

def axL' {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)
    (h : Semiformula.rel r v ∈ Δ) (hn : Semiformula.nrel r v ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (axL Δ r v).wk (by simp[h, hn])

def all' {φ} (h : ∀' φ ∈ Δ) (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : T ⟹ Δ := d.all.wk (by simp [h])

def ex' {φ} (h : ∃' φ ∈ Δ) (t) (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (d.ex t).wk (by simp [h])

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max n m + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max' (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max m n + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

private lemma neg_ne_and {φ ψ : SyntacticFormula L} : ¬∼φ = φ ⋏ ψ :=
  ne_of_ne_complexity (by simp)

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

instance : Tait (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  verum := fun _ Δ => verum Δ
  and := fun dp dq => dp.and dq
  or := fun d => d.or
  wk := fun d ss => d.wk ss
  em := fun hp hn => em hp hn

instance : Tait.Cut (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  cut {_ _ _ dp dn} := cut dp dn

def provableOfDerivable {φ} (b : T ⟹. φ) : T ⊢ φ := b

def specialize {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1} (t : SyntacticTerm L) :
    T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Γ := fun d ↦
  have : T ⟹ ∼φ/[t] :: φ/[t] :: Γ := Tait.em (φ := φ/[t]) (by simp) (by simp)
  have dn : T ⟹ ∼(∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ := by
    simp only [neg_all, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    exact Derivation.ex t (by simpa using this)
  have dp : T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ :=
    Derivation.wk d (List.cons_subset_cons _ <| by simp)
  Derivation.cut dp dn

def specializes : {k : ℕ} → {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L k} → {Γ : Sequent L} → (v : Fin k → SyntacticTerm L) →
    T ⟹ (∀* φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ
  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∀' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ := by simpa using specializes (φ := ∀' φ) (v ·.succ) b
    Derivation.cast (specialize (v 0) this) (by
      simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, ← TransitiveRewriting.comp_app, List.cons.injEq, and_true]; congr 2
      ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
      cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp)

def instances : {k : ℕ} → {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L k} → {Γ : Sequent L} → {v : Fin k → SyntacticTerm L} →
    T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ → T ⟹ (∃* φ) :: Γ
  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∃' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ :=
      ex (v 0) <| Derivation.cast b <| by
        unfold Rewriting.substitute; rw [←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app]; congr 3
        ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
        cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp
    instances (k := k) (v := (v ·.succ)) (Derivation.cast this (by simp))

def allClosureFixitr {φ : SyntacticFormula L} (dp : T ⊢ φ) : (m : ℕ) → T ⊢ ∀* Rew.fixitr 0 m ▹ φ
  | 0     => by exact?

  | root _      => 0

  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

    T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Γ := fun d ↦
  have : T ⟹ ∼φ/[t] :: φ/[t] :: Γ := Tait.em (φ := φ/[t]) (by simp) (by simp)

  Derivation.cut dp dn

informal_statement: The function `exOfInstances'` provides a method to construct a proof that a formula φ holds in a context Γ by substituting instances from a list of terms into the formula.
informal_proof: Given a list `v` of terms, a formula `φ`, and a proof `h` that for every term in `v`, the formula `φ` holds when those terms are substituted into it, the function `exOfInstances'` constructs a new proof that `φ` holds in the original context `Γ`. Essentially, it leverages the existing proofs of `φ` for each term in `v` to establish `φ` in the broader context of `Γ`.

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

protected abbrev cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : T ⟹ Γ := e ▸ d

@[simp] lemma cast_eq (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Δ) : Derivation.cast d e = d := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

alias weakening := wk

def verum' (h : ⊤ ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (verum Δ).wk (by simp[h])

def axL' {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)
    (h : Semiformula.rel r v ∈ Δ) (hn : Semiformula.nrel r v ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (axL Δ r v).wk (by simp[h, hn])

def all' {φ} (h : ∀' φ ∈ Δ) (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : T ⟹ Δ := d.all.wk (by simp [h])

def ex' {φ} (h : ∃' φ ∈ Δ) (t) (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (d.ex t).wk (by simp [h])

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max n m + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max' (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max m n + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

private lemma neg_ne_and {φ ψ : SyntacticFormula L} : ¬∼φ = φ ⋏ ψ :=
  ne_of_ne_complexity (by simp)

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

instance : Tait (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  verum := fun _ Δ => verum Δ
  and := fun dp dq => dp.and dq
  or := fun d => d.or
  wk := fun d ss => d.wk ss

  have : T ⟹ ∼φ/[t] :: φ/[t] :: Γ := Tait.em (φ := φ/[t]) (by simp) (by simp)

  have dp : T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ :=
    Derivation.wk d (List.cons_subset_cons _ <| by simp)
  Derivation.cut dp dn

def specializes : {k : ℕ} → {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L k} → {Γ : Sequent L} → (v : Fin k → SyntacticTerm L) →
    T ⟹ (∀* φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ

  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∀' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ := by simpa using specializes (φ := ∀' φ) (v ·.succ) b
    Derivation.cast (specialize (v 0) this) (by
      simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, ← TransitiveRewriting.comp_app, List.cons.injEq, and_true]; congr 2

      cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp)

  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

instance : Tait (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  verum := fun _ Δ => verum Δ
  and := fun dp dq => dp.and dq
  or := fun d => d.or
  wk := fun d ss => d.wk ss
  em := fun hp hn => em hp hn

instance : Tait.Cut (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  cut {_ _ _ dp dn} := cut dp dn

def provableOfDerivable {φ} (b : T ⟹. φ) : T ⊢ φ := b

def specialize {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1} (t : SyntacticTerm L) :
    T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Γ := fun d ↦
  have : T ⟹ ∼φ/[t] :: φ/[t] :: Γ := Tait.em (φ := φ/[t]) (by simp) (by simp)
  have dn : T ⟹ ∼(∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ := by
    simp only [neg_all, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    exact Derivation.ex t (by simpa using this)
  have dp : T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ :=
    Derivation.wk d (List.cons_subset_cons _ <| by simp)
  Derivation.cut dp dn

    T ⟹ (∀* φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ

  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∀' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ := by simpa using specializes (φ := ∀' φ) (v ·.succ) b
    Derivation.cast (specialize (v 0) this) (by
      simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, ← TransitiveRewriting.comp_app, List.cons.injEq, and_true]; congr 2
      ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
      cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp)

    have : T ⟹ (∃' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ :=
      ex (v 0) <| Derivation.cast b <| by
        unfold Rewriting.substitute; rw [←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app]; congr 3
        ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]

`i = j.succ`, `j : Fin n`. -/

    ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), motive i := induction zero fun i _ => succ i

| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=

    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

private theorem list_foldl' {f : α → List β} {g : α → σ} {h : α → σ × β → σ}
    (hf : haveI := prim H; Primrec f) (hg : Primrec g) (hh : haveI := prim H; Primrec₂ h) :
    Primrec fun a => (f a).foldl (fun s b => h a (s, b)) (g a) := by
  letI := prim H
  let G (a : α) (IH : σ × List β) : σ × List β := List.casesOn IH.2 IH fun b l => (h a (IH.1, b), l)
  have hG : Primrec₂ G := list_casesOn' H (snd.comp snd) snd <|
    to₂ <|
    pair (hh.comp (fst.comp fst) <| pair ((fst.comp snd).comp fst) (fst.comp snd))
      (snd.comp snd)
  let F := fun (a : α) (n : ℕ) => (G a)^[n] (g a, f a)
  have hF : Primrec fun a => (F a (encode (f a))).1 :=
    (fst.comp <|
      nat_iterate (encode_iff.2 hf) (pair hg hf) <|
      hG)
  suffices ∀ a n, F a n = (((f a).take n).foldl (fun s b => h a (s, b)) (g a), (f a).drop n) by
    refine hF.of_eq fun a => ?_
    rw [this, List.take_of_length_le (length_le_encode _)]
  introv
  dsimp only [F]
  generalize f a = l
  generalize g a = x
  induction n generalizing l x with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n IH =>
    simp only [iterate_succ, comp_apply]
    rcases l with - | ⟨b, l⟩ <;> simp [G, IH]

Then, we extend the list `v` by adding an element `t` to it. By applying the induction hypothesis, we can now utilize this new term `t` in our proof.

Using the function `h`, which maps `T` to the updated list `v' = v ++ [t]`, we can now incorporate the new term `t` into our proof. This allows us to ensure that the properties established by `h` are maintained as we extend the list of terms. Finally, by simplifying the constructed proof, we can confirm that it aligns with the expected logical structure and validity.

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

protected abbrev cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : T ⟹ Γ := e ▸ d

@[simp] lemma cast_eq (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Δ) : Derivation.cast d e = d := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

alias weakening := wk

def verum' (h : ⊤ ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (verum Δ).wk (by simp[h])

def axL' {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)
    (h : Semiformula.rel r v ∈ Δ) (hn : Semiformula.nrel r v ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (axL Δ r v).wk (by simp[h, hn])

def all' {φ} (h : ∀' φ ∈ Δ) (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : T ⟹ Δ := d.all.wk (by simp [h])

def ex' {φ} (h : ∃' φ ∈ Δ) (t) (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (d.ex t).wk (by simp [h])

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max n m + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max' (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max m n + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

private lemma neg_ne_and {φ ψ : SyntacticFormula L} : ¬∼φ = φ ⋏ ψ :=
  ne_of_ne_complexity (by simp)

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

instance : Tait (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  verum := fun _ Δ => verum Δ
  and := fun dp dq => dp.and dq
  or := fun d => d.or

  em := fun hp hn => em hp hn

instance : Tait.Cut (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where

def provableOfDerivable {φ} (b : T ⟹. φ) : T ⊢ φ := b

def specialize {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1} (t : SyntacticTerm L) :

    Derivation.wk d (List.cons_subset_cons _ <| by simp)

variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

protected abbrev cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : T ⟹ Γ := e ▸ d

@[simp] lemma cast_eq (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Δ) : Derivation.cast d e = d := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

alias weakening := wk

def verum' (h : ⊤ ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (verum Δ).wk (by simp[h])

def axL' {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)
    (h : Semiformula.rel r v ∈ Δ) (hn : Semiformula.nrel r v ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (axL Δ r v).wk (by simp[h, hn])

def all' {φ} (h : ∀' φ ∈ Δ) (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : T ⟹ Δ := d.all.wk (by simp [h])

def ex' {φ} (h : ∃' φ ∈ Δ) (t) (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (d.ex t).wk (by simp [h])

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max n m + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max' (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max m n + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

private lemma neg_ne_and {φ ψ : SyntacticFormula L} : ¬∼φ = φ ⋏ ψ :=
  ne_of_ne_complexity (by simp)

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

instance : Tait (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  verum := fun _ Δ => verum Δ
  and := fun dp dq => dp.and dq
  or := fun d => d.or
  wk := fun d ss => d.wk ss
  em := fun hp hn => em hp hn

instance : Tait.Cut (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  cut {_ _ _ dp dn} := cut dp dn

def provableOfDerivable {φ} (b : T ⟹. φ) : T ⊢ φ := b

def specialize {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1} (t : SyntacticTerm L) :
    T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Γ := fun d ↦
  have : T ⟹ ∼φ/[t] :: φ/[t] :: Γ := Tait.em (φ := φ/[t]) (by simp) (by simp)
  have dn : T ⟹ ∼(∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ := by
    simp only [neg_all, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    exact Derivation.ex t (by simpa using this)
  have dp : T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ :=
    Derivation.wk d (List.cons_subset_cons _ <| by simp)
  Derivation.cut dp dn

def specializes : {k : ℕ} → {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L k} → {Γ : Sequent L} → (v : Fin k → SyntacticTerm L) →
    T ⟹ (∀* φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ
  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∀' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ := by simpa using specializes (φ := ∀' φ) (v ·.succ) b
    Derivation.cast (specialize (v 0) this) (by
      simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, ← TransitiveRewriting.comp_app, List.cons.injEq, and_true]; congr 2
      ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
      cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp)

/-- Define `f : Π i : Fin n.succ, motive i` by separately handling the cases `i = 0` and
`i = j.succ`, `j : Fin n`. -/
@[elab_as_elim] def cases {motive : Fin (n + 1) → Sort _}
    (zero : motive 0) (succ : ∀ i : Fin n, motive i.succ) :
    ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), motive i := induction zero fun i _ => succ i

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

def specialize {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1} (t : SyntacticTerm L) :
    T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Γ := fun d ↦
  have : T ⟹ ∼φ/[t] :: φ/[t] :: Γ := Tait.em (φ := φ/[t]) (by simp) (by simp)

    exact Derivation.ex t (by simpa using this)
  have dp : T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ :=
    Derivation.wk d (List.cons_subset_cons _ <| by simp)
  Derivation.cut dp dn

lemma eq_rewriteMap_of_funEqOn_fv [DecidableEq ξ₁] (t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) (f g : ξ₁ → Semiterm L ξ₂ n₂) (h : Function.funEqOn t.FVar? f g) :
    Rew.rewriteMap f t = Rew.rewriteMap g t := by
  induction t
  case bvar => simp
  case fvar x => simpa using h x (by simp)
  case func f v ih =>
    simp only [Rew.func, func.injEq, heq_eq_eq, true_and]
    funext i
    exact ih i (fun x hx ↦ h x (by simpa [Semiterm.fvar?_func] using ⟨i, hx⟩))

  unfold Rewriting.substitute; rw [← TransitiveRewriting.comp_app]

rag.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiterm.fvar?_rew

lemma fvar?_rew [DecidableEq ξ₁] [DecidableEq ξ₂]
    {ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂}
    {t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁} {x} :
    (ω t).FVar? x → (∃ i : Fin n₁, (ω #i).FVar? x) ∨ (∃ z : ξ₁, t.FVar? z ∧ (ω &z).FVar? x) := by
  induction t
  case bvar z =>
    intro h; left; exact ⟨z, h⟩
  case fvar z =>
    intro h; right; exact ⟨z, by simp [h]⟩
  case func k F v ih =>
    simp only [Rew.func, fvar?_func, forall_exists_index]
    intro i hx
    rcases ih i hx with (h | ⟨z, hi, hz⟩)
    · left; exact h
    · right; exact ⟨z, ⟨i, hi⟩, hz⟩

  unfold Rewriting.substitute; rw [← TransitiveRewriting.comp_app]
  apply rew_eq_of_funEqOn
  · simp
  · intro x hx
    simp [Rew.comp_app, Rew.fixitr_fvar, Semiformula.lt_fvSup_of_fvar? hx]
