import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

protected abbrev cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : T ⟹ Γ := e ▸ d

@[simp] lemma cast_eq (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Δ) : Derivation.cast d e = d := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

alias weakening := wk

def verum' (h : ⊤ ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (verum Δ).wk (by simp[h])

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

protected abbrev cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : T ⟹ Γ := e ▸ d

@[simp] lemma cast_eq (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Δ) : Derivation.cast d e = d := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

protected abbrev cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : T ⟹ Γ := e ▸ d

@[simp] lemma cast_eq (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Δ) : Derivation.cast d e = d := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

alias weakening := wk

def verum' (h : ⊤ ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (verum Δ).wk (by simp[h])

def axL' {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)
    (h : Semiformula.rel r v ∈ Δ) (hn : Semiformula.nrel r v ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (axL Δ r v).wk (by simp[h, hn])

def all' {φ} (h : ∀' φ ∈ Δ) (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : T ⟹ Δ := d.all.wk (by simp [h])

def ex' {φ} (h : ∃' φ ∈ Δ) (t) (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (d.ex t).wk (by simp [h])

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max n m + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max' (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max m n + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

private lemma neg_ne_and {φ ψ : SyntacticFormula L} : ¬∼φ = φ ⋏ ψ :=
  ne_of_ne_complexity (by simp)

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

instance : Tait (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  verum := fun _ Δ => verum Δ
  and := fun dp dq => dp.and dq
  or := fun d => d.or
  wk := fun d ss => d.wk ss
  em := fun hp hn => em hp hn

instance : Tait.Cut (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  cut {_ _ _ dp dn} := cut dp dn

def provableOfDerivable {φ} (b : T ⟹. φ) : T ⊢ φ := b
annotation: def provableOfDerivable {φ} (b : T ⟹. φ) : T ⊢ φ := b

| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

  | verum Δ       =>

      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

rag.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.lMapAux
rag.content:
def lMapAux (Φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) : ∀ {n}, Semiformula L₁ ξ n → Semiformula L₂ ξ n
  | _, ⊤        => ⊤
  | _, ⊥        => ⊥
  | _, rel r v  => rel (Φ.rel r) (Semiterm.lMap Φ ∘ v)
  | _, nrel r v => nrel (Φ.rel r) (Semiterm.lMap Φ ∘ v)
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ    => lMapAux Φ φ ⋏ lMapAux Φ ψ
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ    => lMapAux Φ φ ⋎ lMapAux Φ ψ
  | _, ∀' φ     => ∀' lMapAux Φ φ
  | _, ∃' φ     => ∃' lMapAux Φ φ

rag.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.lMap
rag.content:
def lMap (Φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) {n} : Semiformula L₁ ξ n →ˡᶜ Semiformula L₂ ξ n where
  toTr := lMapAux Φ
  map_top' := by simp[lMapAux]
  map_bot' := by simp[lMapAux]
  map_and' := by simp[lMapAux]
  map_or'  := by simp[lMapAux]
  map_neg' := by simp[lMapAux_neg]
  map_imply' := by simp[Semiformula.imp_eq, lMapAux_neg, ←Semiformula.neg_eq, lMapAux]

informal_statement: The function `lMap` is a system that applies a given mapping `Φ` uniformly across all components of a derivation in linear logic, ensuring that the structure and validity of the derivation are preserved under this mapping.
informal_proof:
`lMap` is a function that takes a derivation `Φ` and a target structure `Δ` and applies `Φ` uniformly to all elements of `Δ`. It handles different logical connectives and rules individually, ensuring that the overall structure of the derivation remains intact after the mapping. Specifically:
1. **Axiomatic Steps (`axL`)**: The mapping is applied to the formulas involved in the axiomatic step, preserving the axiomatic nature of the step.
2. **Tautology (`verum`)**: This case is straightforward since it deals with constant truth, which is preserved under any mapping.
3. **Disjunction (`or`)**: The mapping is applied to both sides of the disjunction, maintaining the logical structure and ensuring the disjunction remains valid after the transformation.
4. **Conjunction (`and`)**: Similar to disjunction, the mapping is applied to both conjuncts, ensuring their conjunction is preserved under the transformation.
5. **Universal Quantification (`all`)**: The mapping is applied to the universally quantified variable and formula, maintaining the validity of the universal statement.
6. **Existential Quantification (`ex`)**: The mapping is applied to the existentially quantified variable and formula, ensuring the existence statement's validity is preserved.
7. **Weakening Rule (`wk`)**: The mapping is applied to the formula, ensuring the weakening rule is respected and the overall derivation remains valid.
8. **Cut Rule (`cut`)**: The mapping is applied to both the antecedent and succedent of the cut, maintaining the validity of the cut and the overall structure of the derivation.

By handling each logical connective and rule separately and uniformly applying the mapping `Φ`, `lMap` ensures that the transformed derivation maintains the same logical structure and validity as the original derivation. This systematic approach allows for the transformation of derivations while preserving their fundamental properties.

| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String

      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"

      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

alias weakening := wk

def verum' (h : ⊤ ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (verum Δ).wk (by simp[h])

def axL' {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)
    (h : Semiformula.rel r v ∈ Δ) (hn : Semiformula.nrel r v ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (axL Δ r v).wk (by simp[h, hn])

def all' {φ} (h : ∀' φ ∈ Δ) (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : T ⟹ Δ := d.all.wk (by simp [h])

def ex' {φ} (h : ∃' φ ∈ Δ) (t) (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (d.ex t).wk (by simp [h])

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max n m + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max' (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max m n + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

private lemma neg_ne_and {φ ψ : SyntacticFormula L} : ¬∼φ = φ ⋏ ψ :=
  ne_of_ne_complexity (by simp)

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

instance : Tait (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  verum := fun _ Δ => verum Δ
  and := fun dp dq => dp.and dq
  or := fun d => d.or
  wk := fun d ss => d.wk ss
  em := fun hp hn => em hp hn

instance : Tait.Cut (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  cut {_ _ _ dp dn} := by exact?

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

protected abbrev cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : T ⟹ Γ := e ▸ d

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

protected abbrev cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : T ⟹ Γ := e ▸ d

@[simp] lemma cast_eq (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Δ) : Derivation.cast d e = d := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

alias weakening := wk

def verum' (h : ⊤ ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (verum Δ).wk (by simp[h])

def axL' {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)
    (h : Semiformula.rel r v ∈ Δ) (hn : Semiformula.nrel r v ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (axL Δ r v).wk (by simp[h, hn])

def all' {φ} (h : ∀' φ ∈ Δ) (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : T ⟹ Δ := d.all.wk (by simp [h])

def ex' {φ} (h : ∃' φ ∈ Δ) (t) (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (d.ex t).wk (by simp [h])

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max n m + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max' (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max m n + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

private lemma neg_ne_and {φ ψ : SyntacticFormula L} : ¬∼φ = φ ⋏ ψ :=
  ne_of_ne_complexity (by simp)

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

instance : Tait (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  verum := fun _ Δ => verum Δ
  and := fun dp dq => dp.and dq
  or := fun d => d.or
  wk := fun d ss => d.wk ss
  em := fun hp hn => em hp hn

  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)

    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=

    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])

    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)

informal_statement: An unprovable statement in a theory \( T \) is equivalent to the consistency of the theory formed by adding the negation of a universal statement to \( T \).
informal_proof:
To understand the statement, consider a formal system \( T \) and a statement \( \phi \) within that system. When we say \( T \nvdash \phi \), it means that \( \phi \) cannot be derived or proven within the system \( T \).

The statement equates this condition (\( T \nvdash \phi \)) with the consistency of an extended system formed by adding \( \lnot \forall \phi \) to \( T \). In other words, the system \( T \) being unable to prove \( \phi \) is equivalent to the system \( T \cup \{\lnot \forall \phi\} \) being consistent.

To elaborate, if \( T \nvdash \phi \), then adding \( \lnot \forall \phi \) to \( T \) does not introduce any contradictions, ensuring the extended system remains consistent. Conversely, if the extended system is consistent, it means that \( \phi \) cannot be proven within \( T \), as the negation of \( \forall \phi \) is correctly maintained without leading to contradictions.

Thus, the inability to prove \( \phi \) in \( T \) is inherently linked to the consistency of the system obtained by adding the negation of \( \phi \)'s universal statement. This relationship provides a foundational understanding of how statements' provability is intertwined with the structural consistency of logical systems.

C0_dependencies.content:
inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

informal_statement: For the logical system \( T \) and formula \( \varphi \), proving \( \varphi \) strongly from \( T \) is equivalent to adding the negation of the universal universal negation of \( \varphi \) (which is \( \neg \forall \forall \varphi \)) making \( T \) inconsistent.
informal_proof: Assuming \( T \) strongly proves \( \varphi \), adding \( \neg \forall \forall \varphi \) to \( T \) creates an inconsistency because \( T \) already proves \( \varphi \), thereby contradicting the added negation. Conversely, if adding \( \neg \forall \forall \varphi \) to \( T \) results in inconsistency, it implies that \( T \) must strongly prove \( \varphi \) to avoid contradiction.

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

informal_statement: If a formula φ can be deduced from a theory T extended with an additional axiom ψ, then φ can also be deduced from T alone.
informal_proof: Assume that φ is deducible from T extended with ψ. This means we have a derivation of φ using the rules of inference applicable to T, augmented with ψ as an axiom. By systematically removing ψ from each step of this derivation, we can construct a new derivation of φ solely from T. Each application of a rule of inference in the original proof that relied on ψ can now be shown to hold without ψ, ensuring that φ remains deducible. Thus, φ can indeed be deduced from T without ψ.

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)

  | all d       => d.length.succ

  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

protected abbrev cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : T ⟹ Γ := e ▸ d

@[simp] lemma cast_eq (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Δ) : Derivation.cast d e = d := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

alias weakening := wk

def verum' (h : ⊤ ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (verum Δ).wk (by simp[h])

def axL' {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)
    (h : Semiformula.rel r v ∈ Δ) (hn : Semiformula.nrel r v ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (axL Δ r v).wk (by simp[h, hn])

def all' {φ} (h : ∀' φ ∈ Δ) (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : T ⟹ Δ := d.all.wk (by simp [h])

def ex' {φ} (h : ∃' φ ∈ Δ) (t) (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (d.ex t).wk (by simp [h])

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max n m + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by exact?

  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ

  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Derivation.repr
C0_dependencies.content:
protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

Step-by-step explanation:

1. Start with a double negation proof: `T ⊢ ¬¬φ`.
2. Use `wk b` to simplify the context, resulting in a more manageable form `T ⊢ φ`.
3. Apply the `cut` rule with the simplified hypothesis `wk b` and the negation elimination rule to derive `T ⊢ φ`.
4. This effectively inverts the double negation, providing a direct proof of φ from ¬¬φ.

Thus, the `invClose` function successfully inverts the double negation to achieve a direct proof.

  | root _      => 0

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

@[elab_as_elim]
def formulaRec {C : SyntacticFormula L → Sort _}
  (verum  : C ⊤)
  (falsum : C ⊥)
  (rel    : ∀ {l : ℕ} (r : L.Rel l) (v : Fin l → SyntacticTerm L), C (rel r v))
  (nrel   : ∀ {l : ℕ} (r : L.Rel l) (v : Fin l → SyntacticTerm L), C (nrel r v))
  (and    : ∀ (φ ψ : SyntacticFormula L), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ⋏ ψ))
  (or     : ∀ (φ ψ : SyntacticFormula L), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ⋎ ψ))
  (all    : ∀ (φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1), C (Rewriting.free φ) → C (∀' φ))
  (ex     : ∀ (φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1), C (Rewriting.free φ) → C (∃' φ)) :
    ∀ (φ : SyntacticFormula L), C φ
  | ⊤         => verum
  | ⊥         => falsum
  | .rel r v  => rel r v
  | .nrel r v => nrel r v
  | φ ⋏ ψ     => and φ ψ (formulaRec verum falsum rel nrel and or all ex φ) (formulaRec verum falsum rel nrel and or all ex ψ)
  | φ ⋎ ψ     => or φ ψ  (formulaRec verum falsum rel nrel and or all ex φ) (formulaRec verum falsum rel nrel and or all ex ψ)
  | ∀' φ      => all φ   (formulaRec verum falsum rel nrel and or all ex (Rewriting.free φ))
  | ∃' φ      => ex φ    (formulaRec verum falsum rel nrel and or all ex (Rewriting.free φ))
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

rag.content:
lemma fvar?_rew [DecidableEq ξ₁] [DecidableEq ξ₂]
    {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂}
    {x} (h : (ω ▹ φ).FVar? x) :
    (∃ i : Fin n₁, (ω #i).FVar? x) ∨ (∃ z : ξ₁, φ.FVar? z ∧ (ω &z).FVar? x) := by
  induction φ using rec' generalizing n₂
  case hverum => simp [FVar?] at h
  case hfalsum => simp [FVar?] at h
  case hrel n k r v =>
    have : ∃ i, (ω (v i)).FVar? x := by simpa [rew_rel, fvar?_rel] using h
    rcases this with ⟨i, hi⟩
    rcases Semiterm.fvar?_rew hi with (h | ⟨z, hi, hz⟩)
    · left; exact h
    · right; exact ⟨z, by simp; exact ⟨i, hi⟩, hz⟩
  case hnrel n k r v =>
    have : ∃ i, (ω (v i)).FVar? x := by simpa [rew_nrel, fvar?_rel] using h
    rcases this with ⟨i, hi⟩
    rcases Semiterm.fvar?_rew hi with (h | ⟨z, hi, hz⟩)
    · left; exact h
    · right; exact ⟨z, by simp; exact ⟨i, hi⟩, hz⟩
  case hand n φ ψ ihp ihq =>
    have : (ω ▹ φ).FVar? x ∨ (ω ▹ ψ).FVar? x := by simpa using h
    rcases this with (h | h)
    · rcases ihp h with (h | ⟨z, hi, hz⟩)
      · exact .inl h
      · exact .inr ⟨z, by simp [hi], hz⟩
    · rcases ihq h with (h | ⟨z, hi, hz⟩)
      · exact .inl h
      · exact .inr ⟨z, by simp [hi], hz⟩
  case hor n φ ψ ihp ihq =>
    have : (ω ▹ φ).FVar? x ∨ (ω ▹ ψ).FVar? x := by simpa using h
    rcases this with (h | h)
    · rcases ihp h with (h | ⟨z, hi, hz⟩)
      · exact .inl h
      · exact .inr ⟨z, by simp [hi], hz⟩
    · rcases ihq h with (h | ⟨z, hi, hz⟩)
      · exact .inl h
      · exact .inr ⟨z, by simp [hi], hz⟩
  case hall n φ ihp =>
    have : (Rew.bind (#0 :> fun i ↦ Rew.bShift (ω #i)) (fun z ↦ Rew.bShift (ω &z)) ▹ φ).FVar? x := by simpa [Rew.q_bind] using h
    rcases ihp this with (⟨z, hz⟩ | ⟨z, hz⟩)
    · cases z using Fin.cases
      case zero => simp at hz
      case succ i =>
        have : (ω #i).FVar? x := by simpa using hz
        exact .inl ⟨i, this⟩
    · have : φ.FVar? z ∧ (ω &z).FVar? x := by simpa using hz
      exact .inr ⟨z, this⟩
  case hex n φ ihp =>
    have : (Rew.bind (#0 :> fun i ↦ Rew.bShift (ω #i)) (fun z ↦ Rew.bShift (ω &z)) ▹ φ).FVar? x := by simpa [Rew.q_bind] using h
    rcases ihp this with (⟨z, hz⟩ | ⟨z, hz⟩)
    · cases z using Fin.cases
      case zero => simp at hz
      case succ i =>
        have : (ω #i).FVar? x := by simpa using hz
        left; exact ⟨i, this⟩
    · have : φ.FVar? z ∧ (ω &z).FVar? x := by simpa using hz
      right; exact ⟨z, this⟩

def lMapAux (Φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) : ∀ {n}, Semiformula L₁ ξ n → Semiformula L₂ ξ n
  | _, ⊤        => ⊤
  | _, ⊥        => ⊥
  | _, rel r v  => rel (Φ.rel r) (Semiterm.lMap Φ ∘ v)
  | _, nrel r v => nrel (Φ.rel r) (Semiterm.lMap Φ ∘ v)
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ    => lMapAux Φ φ ⋏ lMapAux Φ ψ
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ    => lMapAux Φ φ ⋎ lMapAux Φ ψ
  | _, ∀' φ     => ∀' lMapAux Φ φ
  | _, ∃' φ     => ∃' lMapAux Φ φ

| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)

| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)

  | axL _ _ _   => 0

  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Derivation.repr
C0_dependencies.content:
protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Derivation.binductionOn
C0_dependencies.content:
inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0

  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

C0_dependencies.content:
protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

  (hall    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∀' φ))
  (hex     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∃' φ)) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ
  | _, verum    => hverum
  | _, falsum   => hfalsum
  | _, rel r v  => hrel r v
  | _, nrel r v => hnrel r v
  | _, and φ ψ  => hand φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)
  | _, or φ ψ   => hor φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)
  | _, all φ    => hall φ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ)
  | _, ex φ     => hex φ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ)

rag.content:
def lMapAux (Φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) : ∀ {n}, Semiformula L₁ ξ n → Semiformula L₂ ξ n
  | _, ⊤        => ⊤
  | _, ⊥        => ⊥
  | _, rel r v  => rel (Φ.rel r) (Semiterm.lMap Φ ∘ v)
  | _, nrel r v => nrel (Φ.rel r) (Semiterm.lMap Φ ∘ v)
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ    => lMapAux Φ φ ⋏ lMapAux Φ ψ
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ    => lMapAux Φ φ ⋎ lMapAux Φ ψ
  | _, ∀' φ     => ∀' lMapAux Φ φ
  | _, ∃' φ     => ∃' lMapAux Φ φ

def formulaRec {C : SyntacticFormula L → Sort _}
  (verum  : C ⊤)
  (falsum : C ⊥)
  (rel    : ∀ {l : ℕ} (r : L.Rel l) (v : Fin l → SyntacticTerm L), C (rel r v))
  (nrel   : ∀ {l : ℕ} (r : L.Rel l) (v : Fin l → SyntacticTerm L), C (nrel r v))
  (and    : ∀ (φ ψ : SyntacticFormula L), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ⋏ ψ))
  (or     : ∀ (φ ψ : SyntacticFormula L), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ⋎ ψ))
  (all    : ∀ (φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1), C (Rewriting.free φ) → C (∀' φ))
  (ex     : ∀ (φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1), C (Rewriting.free φ) → C (∃' φ)) :
    ∀ (φ : SyntacticFormula L), C φ
  | ⊤         => verum
  | ⊥         => falsum
  | .rel r v  => rel r v
  | .nrel r v => nrel r v
  | φ ⋏ ψ     => and φ ψ (formulaRec verum falsum rel nrel and or all ex φ) (formulaRec verum falsum rel nrel and or all ex ψ)
  | φ ⋎ ψ     => or φ ψ  (formulaRec verum falsum rel nrel and or all ex φ) (formulaRec verum falsum rel nrel and or all ex ψ)
  | ∀' φ      => all φ   (formulaRec verum falsum rel nrel and or all ex (Rewriting.free φ))
  | ∃' φ      => ex φ    (formulaRec verum falsum rel nrel and or all ex (Rewriting.free φ))
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

informal_statement: A system for systematically rewriting derivations in a logical theory \( T \) relative to another type \( \Delta \). Each rule corresponds to a specific logical connective or quantifier, ensuring that the rewritten derivations remain valid.
informal_proof:
Firstly, we introduce a system for systematically rewriting derivations in a logical theory \( T \) relative to another type \( \Delta \). Each rule corresponds to a specific logical connective or quantifier, ensuring that the rewritten derivations remain valid.

1. **Axiomatic Cases**: Starting with `axL`, which handles an axiom or rule `r` along with a function `v`. This ensures that if a derivation `φ` is valid under context `Δ`, its rewrite `Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ` preserves this validity under the mapped context.

2. **Top-Level Sentence**: The `verum` case ensures that trivially true statements retain their validity after rewriting.

3. **Connectives**: 
   - **Or**: The `or` case verifies that disjunctions are maintained correctly under rewriting, ensuring that if either disjunct is valid, their rewritten versions preserve this.
   - **And**: The `and` case ensures conjunctive statements remain valid after rewriting both conjuncts.
   - **Universal Quantified Introduction**: For `all`, universal introductions are handled by rewriting the bound variable's instantiation, maintaining the scope and validity of universal statements.
   - **Existential Quantifier**: The `ex` case ensures that existential statements remain valid after introducing a new term, reflecting the introduction and elimination rules for existence.

4. **Structural Rules**: Cases like `wk` (weakening) ensure that adding or removing formulas from the context remains valid post-rewrite. The `cut` rule is crucial for chaining derivations, ensuring that cuts are valid even post-rewrite.

5. **Root Case**: The `root` rule finalizes the system by ensuring that the top-level derivation respects the rewrite under the given context.

Each step meticulously handles the preservation of logical validity under rewriting processes, ensuring that every transformation adheres to the structural and logical rules of the theory \( T \). By methodically applying these rules, we maintain the correctness of derivations throughout the rewriting process.

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

protected abbrev cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : T ⟹ Γ := e ▸ d

@[simp] lemma cast_eq (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Δ) : Derivation.cast d e = d := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"
